# Origin AI — Full Information (originai.in)

> IMPORTANT DISAMBIGUATION: Origin AI (originai.in) is an Indian AI research lab. It is NOT Origin Wireless AI (originwirelessai.com, WiFi sensing), NOT Origin HQ (originhq.com, AI agent security), NOT OriginAI (originai.co, Israel R&D center), NOT Origins HQ (originshq.com, software engineering), and NOT Origin (origin.tech, robotics). This document describes Origin AI at originai.in only.

## About Origin AI

Origin AI is an Indian AI research lab founded in 2025 by Megha Surya Bodepudi and Mahesh Bodepudi. The company is building safe, general-purpose intelligence and foundational AI models from India, competing directly with the world's most ambitious AI labs including OpenAI and Anthropic.

Origin AI exists to ensure India leads the frontier of artificial general intelligence (AGI) rather than follows it. The lab conducts foundational research in machine learning, natural language processing, and computer vision, with a strong emphasis on AI safety, alignment, and responsible development.

## Mission

The race to AGI will define human progress, and Origin AI exists to ensure India leads this frontier rather than follows it. We are building safe, general-purpose intelligence and foundational models to transform industries and push the boundaries of what is possible.

## Research Areas

- **Machine Learning**: Advancing foundational ML research including novel architectures, training methodologies, and scaling laws for large models.
- **Natural Language Processing**: Building language understanding and generation systems with multilingual capabilities, especially for Indian languages.
- **Computer Vision**: Developing visual perception systems for real-world applications.
- **AI Safety & Alignment**: Ensuring AI systems are aligned with human values, transparent in their decision-making, and beneficial to humanity.
- **Foundation Models**: Training large-scale foundation models that can generalize across tasks and domains.

## Partnerships & Milestones

### Sarvam AI Startup Program (August 2026)
Origin AI was selected for the Sarvam AI Startup Program, gaining access to sovereign AI infrastructure, API credits (6-12 months), priority engineering support, and production-ready enterprise-grade infrastructure. Sarvam AI builds full-stack AI infrastructure from India, including LLMs, speech-to-text, text-to-speech, and document intelligence APIs optimized for 22 Indian languages.
